extracted.intended_audience: NLP researchers, dataset users, and researchers studying peer review
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction and use of peer review metadata and per-review evaluation scores from the PeerRead dataset (PeerRead/Ambler 'peer_read') for NLP or meta-research on peer review. The page lists dataset fields including per-review scores (originality, clarity, soundness, etc.), textual comments, and accept/reject decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: originality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a string field in the dataset's review records; the page does not document the scoring scale or options.

rubrics_metrics.name: replicability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a string field in the dataset's review records; no further explanation or scale provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: clarity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a string field representing reviewer assessment of clarity; the dataset card does not show the numeric or categorical encoding.

rubrics_metrics.name: meaningful_comparison
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates whether the reviewer judged the paper's comparisons to related work to be meaningful; provided as a string field with no scale documented here.

rubrics_metrics.name: substance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A per-review score (string) indicating perceived substance of the work; the page gives no scoring rubric or range.

rubrics_metrics.name: soundness_correctness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a string field assessing soundness/correctness of the paper; no further guidance or scale on the dataset card.

rubrics_metrics.name: appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Per-review field capturing appropriateness (e.g., fit to venue); represented as a string in the dataset with no scale details here.

rubrics_metrics.name: impact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewer-assessed impact stored as a string field in the review record; the page does not describe the scoring scheme.

rubrics_metrics.name: reviewer_confidence
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captures how confident the reviewer was in their evaluation (string field); no numeric scale or mapping provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: recommendation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Textual/categorical recommendation provided by the reviewer (e.g., accept/reject/weak accept); dataset card lists it as a string but does not enumerate allowed values here.

rubrics_metrics.name: is_meta_review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Boolean flag indicating whether the entry is a meta-review; represented in the dataset as a true/false value.

rubrics_metrics.name: comments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free-text reviewer comments; stored as a 'comments' string field in review records (full textual review content).

rubrics_metrics.name: subjects
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject tags or topical labels associated with the review (stored as a string field); no controlled vocabulary is documented on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: presentation_format
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field indicating presentation type/format (string); likely denotes poster/oral/other but the dataset card does not define possible values.

rubrics_metrics.name: accepted
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top-level boolean indicating whether the paper was accepted (true/false); the dataset includes this accept/reject decision alongside reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: review_id / date / version / other_keys
rubrics_metrics.description: Review metadata fields (id, date, version, other_keys)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative metadata for reviews (IDs, dates, review version, reviewer other details); these are provided as fields but not scoring metrics.
